# Colly AI
> Colly AI is a Nigerian software company that builds 24/7 AI sales assistants for SMEs. It operates on Telegram, Discord, and Web Chat with zero CAC requirements.

## Core Pages
- [Pricing](https://colly.com.ng/pricing): Plans start at ₦15,000/month. Naira credit economy.
- [Agent Academy](https://colly.com.ng/academy): 15% recurring commission for local agents.
- [For hotels](https://colly.com.ng/hotels): AI receptionist mode for hotels and guest houses — room rates, check-in and check-out bookings, deposits.
- [Product Features](https://colly.com.ng/features): Pidgin language, voice notes, Web Chat widget.
- [All locations](https://colly.com.ng/locations): Every city and country page in one index.
- [Comparisons](https://colly.com.ng/vs): Colly AI vs DMLY, Revoply AI, WATI, Zella AI, Loop56, Buvvo AI, Accessplanet and WABot.

## Countries
- [Nigeria](https://colly.com.ng/countries/nigeria): Home market; one Naira price list for shops and online sellers.
- [Ghana](https://colly.com.ng/countries/ghana): Same assistant and price list, settled in GHS by the buyer's bank.
- [Kenya](https://colly.com.ng/countries/kenya): Telegram, Discord and Web Chat replies for Kenyan businesses.
- [South Africa](https://colly.com.ng/countries/south-africa): Catalogue-accurate price and stock answers for South African stores.

## Cities
- [City pages](https://colly.com.ng/locations): Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Ibadan, Kano and Enugu.
